pages.markdown:
Reach users wherever they are with
a single unified platformSENDQUICK.IO FEATURES
SendQuick.io provides you with the convenience to 
quickly and easily chat with your customers on all the 
popular chat messenger platforms.
You do not need to get troubled over connecting to the 
popular channels where your customers are.
Easy Configuration
We provide a step-by-step guide and support throughout 
your entire onboarding process for all supported chat 
messengers and collaboration tools.
SendQuick.io API does all the updates and connections 
for you, without any change, and without charges as 
well. You can continue focusing on your business and 
applications with a peace of mind.No user limits when you use our service
We do not limit any number of channels or accounts you 
wish to connect to.
Why should we?
Our role is to allow you to connect, use and focus on your 
business messaging delivery.
